description.fr: Deuxième ouvrage de la série School Life (le premier étant Feng Ling's Special Eugenics).Cette année, les chats chanceux (maneki-neko) passent leur diplôme. Leur certification officielle comme « esprits de la chance » dépend d’un seul critère : réussir l’examen final en 100 jours. Pour valider leur épreuve, ils doivent, grâce à leur technique d’appât de la richesse, amasser 100 000 yuans offerts par des humains.Les chats sont donc envoyés dans le monde des mortels... et le défi commence.Notre protagoniste, le chat Ling Shan, se casse la patte droite dès son arrivée. Problème : sa fameuse technique d’appât de la richesse (ce geste emblématique où le maneki-neko agite sa patte droite) devient inutilisable.Alors qu’il est au bout du rouleau, Ling Shan est secouru par Chen Sha, un étudiant d’une école technique, qui l’emmène se faire soigner. Résultat : 13 000 yuans dépensés pour l’opération et les soins — ce qui propulse Ling Shan en tête du classement dès la première semaine !Reconnaissant et touché, Ling Shan décide de s’attacher à cet humain au grand cœur.Mais... depuis ce jour, Chen Sha n’a pas dépensé un seul yuan de plus ! Ling Shan refuse pourtant d’abandonner : il compte bien faire de son mieux pour réussir sa mission... coûte que coûte.Ce projet sera  en-coprod avec la team Karma Bl

description.zh: 安生重生醒来之后，发现已经过了三万年，人类灭绝了，精灵取代了人类地球霸主的地位。   　　当第一具人类化石被挖出来后，整个精灵社会震惊了。   　　研究人类，考古人类，成了学术界的热门课题。   　　安生激活系统，能够重播人类遗迹或文物的历史！   　　万里长城，浮生授经，紫金皇城，神舟登月，乃至原子弹研发..   　　这些魔法种族们终于明白了，三万年前，有那么一段曼妙的流光。   　　人类不是茹毛饮血的野兽，不是智力低下的裸猿。   　　他们的力量胜过任何魔法，他们的足迹横跨所有王朝，他们将大地披上钢铁的纵横，他们将群星连上电波的魔法...   　　 　　而安生的目的只有一个，借考古的人类遗迹推动精灵的基因科技，找到遗留的‘人类基因库’，悄悄将人类复活！

description.en: To treat his uncontrollable magic power, Duke Christopher proposes marriage to Lady Cecilia, the daughter of a noble family. Cecilia, who agrees under certain terms, enters into a marriage where she is expected to help him with his treatment. As they live together, they gradually come to understand each other. Though their relationship begins as a contract, the two slowly grow closer as they share time and experiences. As their bond deepens, Cecilia begins to question her own role—not just as a noble's daughter but as Christopher’s wife. She starts to fall for him, even though she fears she may one day lose her powers. Although troubled by these thoughts, she becomes determined to support her husband as a true partner. During this time, a war breaks out, and Christopher heads to the battlefield. There, his magic surges out of control. Just as he is on the verge of collapse, Cecilia, who has rushed to his side, helps suppress the magic, deepening the emotional bond between them. However, the defeated general's daughter sets her sights on Christopher, plotting to take him for herself and threatening Cecilia's place. Even so, Cecilia never loses heart. She receives magical aid and confronts Louise. After Louise’s retreat, Cecilia and Christopher reaffirm their connection. With the Empress granting them her blessing, the two begin a new chapter of their lives together.
description.ru:
Чтобы справиться с необычной магической силой, герцог Кристофер вынужден вступить в сложные и непростые отношения с дочерью маркиза, Сесилией. Их знакомство начинается с взаимного недоверия и конфликтов, но постепенно между ними возникает напряжение, которое сложно игнорировать. В мире интриг, магии и дворцовых тайн их отношения подвергаются проверке, сталкиваясь с претендентами на власть, секретами прошлого и опасностями, которые грозят изменить их жизни навсегда.

Эта манхва сочетает романтику, магию и драму, обещая захватывающую историю о доверии, любви и испытаниях, через которые герои проходят вместе.

description.en:
Jiang Zhao is suddenly transported to an interstellar era. In this age, nearly everyone is born through genetic modification and has become a beastman with powerful combat abilities. However, these modified genes also bring defects: from birth, beastmen live under the threat of “mental power rampage,” which can ultimately lead them to be completely overtaken by their beast instincts.
Jiang Zhao, as the only pure ancient human in the entire universe, has a special effect — just by being near him, others’ mental unrest settles, and they find peace and comfort. Jiang Zhao’s attitude: “Isn’t it just petting fluffy fur? I’m good with that!”

The guys who act as divine retribution for beings have found their way to Earth. These beings have found their way from an ancient Korean dynasty to the present day. Many unique figures get involved after a string of murders, and since then things grow more hectic

Set in 18th-century China during the Manchu-led Qing dynasty, the novel follows the quest of the Red Flower Society, a secret organisation aiming to overthrow the Qing government, and their entanglements with an Islamic tribe in western China. The "book" in the title refers to a Quran that was stolen from the tribe while the "sword" refers to a sword given to the protagonist, Chen Jialuo, by his first romantic interest, Huoqingtong. Historical figures such as the Qianlong Emperor, Zhaohui, Heshen, Zheng Banqiao and Fuk'anggan also make appearances or are mentioned by name in the novel. One of the female protagonists, Princess Fragrance, is loosely based on the Qianlong Emperor's Fragrant Concubine.
